summary: HVII, a Cayman SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing a forward purchase agreement dated September 22, 2026 with New Circle Capital Solutions LP covering up to 5,000,000 Class A ordinary shares. The seller is prepaid an amount equal to shares times the per-share redemption price at the closing of the previously announced business combination with ONE Nuclear Energy LLC (agreement dated October 22, 2025, amended March 31, June 1 and August 7, 2026). Post-closing, HVII becomes ONE Nuclear Energy Inc. Prepayment is due one business day after closing or upon trust disbursement; seller may unwind on exchange business days. Watch redemption levels, closing timing and forward unwind overhang.
